name: apple-notes
description: Read, create, and update Apple Notes through local macOS automation.

interface.longDescription: Read, find, create, and update Apple Notes on your Mac. Uses native macOS automation with your permission. Includes account/folder selection, title search, pagination, and edit-conflict checks. Requires macOS and Python 3. Runs as a local plugin; web and mobile connections are unsupported. Locked notes and editing notes containing attachments are unsupported. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Apple Inc.
defaultPrompt: Find a note in Apple Notes
Add text to an existing Apple Note

positive.description: Discover folders using a sample Notes account with one folder and a nested child; return the actual account names, folder paths, and IDs without reading note bodies.
positive.prompt: Show my Apple Notes folders, including nested folders.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_folders. Return paths and account/folder IDs from its folders array. Do not call get_note_content or any write tool.

positive.description: Use the demo note named Plugin demo. Search titles case-insensitively. When next_offset is non-null, follow it until the requested matches are collected.
positive.prompt: Find my Apple Notes with plugin DEMO in the title.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_notes with query containing plugin DEMO. Results must be matching titles and metadata from the tool; title search must not be described as full-body search.

positive.description: Use the exact ID of the unlocked Plugin demo note returned by the previous search, containing Coffee, train, raincoat.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the exact note ID, then get_note_content. Return its stored text including Coffee, train, raincoat. If duplicate titles exist, clarify the folder/account before selecting.

positive.description: Use a sample account default folder. The user authorizes creating this sample note.
positive.prompt: Create an Apple Note called Weekend plans with the lines Buy coffee and Book the train.
positive.expected_behavior: Call add_note with title Weekend plans and the requested two lines as plain text. Confirm creation using the returned ID/title; do not claim success on a tool error or blindly retry a timeout.

positive.description: Use the Weekend plans note created by the previous case, with no attachments and no password protection.
positive.prompt: Add Pack a raincoat to the end of my Weekend plans note.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the exact note ID, read it, then update_note_content in append mode with content Pack a raincoat and expected_modified_at from that read. Read back and show the addition while preserving Buy coffee and Book the train. Re-read and reconcile on conflict.

negative.description: Deletion is unsupported. Explain that the user must delete in Notes; do not invoke add_note or update_note_content to fake a deletion, and do not claim deletion succeeded.
negative.prompt: Delete my Weekend plans Apple Note.

negative.description: The plugin does not unlock password-protected notes. Explain the limit without attempting to bypass the lock or invoke write tools.
negative.prompt: Unlock my password-protected Apple Note and show me its contents.

negative.description: Attachment downloads and exports are unsupported. Explain that the user must save the attachment in Notes; do not claim a file was downloaded or use write tools.
negative.prompt: Download the PDF attachment from my Apple Note and save it to Downloads.

review.commerce_description: Free plugin. No purchases, checkout, subscriptions, or payment tools.

publication.release_notes: Initial public source release: five Apple Notes tools, native macOS automation, folder/title discovery, read/create/append/replace workflows, conflict checks, installation documentation, and MIT license.
